channels.title: Stores
channels.subtitle: Connect your online stores and keep products, stock and orders in step with Inventory.
channels.emptyBody: Connect a Shopify store to publish products from Inventory and bring its orders in.

provider.shopify: Publish products, sync stock and import orders from a Shopify store.

connect.title: Connect a Shopify store
connect.step1: In Shopify admin, open Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps and create an app.
connect.step2: Allow Admin API access for products, inventory, locations and orders (read and write).
connect.step3: Install the app and copy the Admin API access token.
connect.name: Store name
connect.nameHint: Only shown here, so you can tell stores apart.
connect.tokenHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.
connect.locationBody: Shopify tracks stock per location. Stock from Inventory will be set at the location you choose.

card.pausedNote: Syncing is paused for this store.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.locationHint: Changing it does not move stock already in Shopify.
settings.importOrdersHint: Bring new store orders in and take their stock from Inventory.
settings.syncContentHint: Names, descriptions, photos, prices and SEO.
settings.syncStockHint: Keep quantities in the store matching Inventory.
settings.pauseHint: Nothing is sent or imported while paused.
settings.newTokenHint: Use this if the token was revoked or has expired.
settings.resetHint: Overwrite the store quantities with Inventory's current stock.
settings.resetConfirmBody: Every quantity in the store will be replaced with what Inventory holds now.

sync.nothing: Everything was already up to date.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnect.body: Products already in the store stay there. Nothing more is synced or imported.

listings.title: Store listings
listings.subtitle: Inventory listings published to your connected stores.
listings.publishSubtitle: Pick the store, then the listing to send.
listings.empty: Nothing published to a store yet.
listings.removeBody: It will no longer be kept in step with {{store}}.
listings.alsoInStore: Also delete the product in the store

orders.title: Online orders
orders.subtitle: Orders imported from your stores. Their stock is taken from Inventory.
